description: Self-hosted file library on Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1: browsing, protected folders, shares, short links, media playback, WebDAV and upload quotas.
name: pan

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist public && wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir dist --output-routes-path dist/_routes.json --compatibility-date 2026-11-03 --project-directory . && cp index.html admin.html 404.html favicon.ico robots.txt public/ && cp -r admin assets public/
